d: From litter box problems and destructive behaviour to aggression and unexpected cat attacks, Jackson Galaxy takes on some of the most challenging cat behaviour cases! This compilation brings together the best moments from My Cat From Hell, featuring the renowned cat behaviourist and cat expert as he helps families understand their feline companions. Explore complex cases involving insecure attachment, lack of social skills, trauma-induced cat behaviour, territorial marking and environmental triggers. Watch Jackson tackle high-energy feline behaviour through positive reinforcement,…
